acceptanceCriteria.text: Manager domain/persistence exposes a stable canonical `runtime_id` (or equivalent) for every configured/managed Runtime.
Runtime-scoped API routes/results require and return that identity consistently.
Local/remote/existing Runtime targets share one identity/state model.
Runtime display name/address changes do not silently create a new authority identity unless the contract requires it.
Restart preserves Runtime identity/config state without persisting credential bytes.
Missing/ambiguous/stale Runtime references fail closed rather than selecting a default reachable Runtime.
Tests cover multiple Runtimes, renamed/display-changed target, restart, missing target, and identity collision/rejection.

issue.title: feat: add Runtime-scoped identity to the Manager domain and API
